svg.aria-label: Proposta B, Margem: a marca Moreira e Vaz atrás de uma régua vertical, com a linha de referência por baixo
svg.title: Proposta B: Margem
svg.desc: Type only: the handbook's opening rule turned vertical, the wordmark in Source Serif 4 semibold beside it, and under it a one-line descriptor in Atkinson Hyperlegible, as a margin reference sits beside an entry.
